programme.title: 勞德之家 [英/普]
programme.desc: 林肯若想觀賞他最喜愛的節目最後一集,就得打敗每一個姐妹,搶先佔到沙發.// 林肯在蘿莉的語音信箱中留下傷人留言,他意識到自己必須在蘿莉聽見之前,先行刪除該留言.

programme.title: 勞德之家 [英/普]
programme.desc: 林肯受夠了姐妹干涉他的事情,直到他在學校發生霸凌事件.// 為了贏得學校影片大賽,林肯偷偷錄下自家姐妹最丟臉的時刻.

programme.title: 勞德之家 [英/普]
programme.desc: 麗莎用她的新發明,復活了一位舊石器時代的女性.

programme.title: 雷霆家族:雙生臥底
programme.desc: 比利前來拜訪,希望他的新搭檔史帝夫能夠加入桑德曼聯盟.菲碧和麥斯考慮了一下,但很快就發現他的超能力是製作棉花糖.他們拒絕史帝夫加入桑德曼聯盟後,他卻變得邪惡並發誓要復仇.

programme.title: 超能小子亨利
programme.desc: 獲得好景市最尊榮的餐廳邀請時,亨利決定帶著他的老大雷前往,但是他發現情況比想像中複雜.

programme.title: 海綿寶寶 [英/普]
programme.desc: 海綿寶寶突然想要和水母一樣過著自由自在的自然生活於是他辭掉工作,決定回歸自然去可是他在野外根本無法生活.// 章魚哥為了要賣房子,編了個相反的謊言騙海綿寶寶.

programme.title: 海綿寶寶 [英/普]
programme.desc: 蟹堡王餐廳最近生意都不太好,於是蟹老闆就接受章魚哥的建議舉辦了一場才藝表演.// 皮老闆又來偷美味蟹堡了,遭到大家的辱罵,好心的海綿寶寶認為只要跟皮老闆做朋友,他就會變好了.

programme.title: 海綿寶寶 [英/普]
programme.desc: 弱小的海綿寶寶一心想要變成超級猛男,他很努力的跟珊迪學健身.// 海綿寶寶和派大星不小心把章魚哥的蠟像溶掉了,他們以為自己害死了章魚哥.

programme.title: 海綿寶寶 [英/普]
programme.desc: 疼愛女兒珍珍的蟹老闆,為了阻止珍珍一直哭下去,派海綿寶寶陪著珍珍去參加畢業舞會.// 海綿寶寶為了爭取本月最佳員工獎,又和章魚哥摃上了,他們拚了命力求工作表現.

programme.title: 派大星秀 [英/普]
programme.desc: 酷鯊哥利用派大星和宇宙中最阿呆的外星人溝通. // 派大星和派大爺為了要舔烘焙湯匙的最後一口,而進行一場互看大對決.

programme.title: 派大星秀 [英/普]
programme.desc: 海星家再一次發生災難後,消防隊長要求派大星觀看安全宣導片. // 派大星在上流購物中心升遷失敗.

programme.title: 忍者龜之都市傳奇 [英/普]
programme.desc: 主教這名女子的起源故事!她為何痛恨變種人?機械體有什麼祕密?還有忍者龜落入主教陷阱的那晚,究竟發生了什麼事?

programme.title: 忍者龜之都市傳奇 [英/普]
programme.desc: 忍者龜找上主教,但她早已有所準備,機甲主教的逆襲!但是機械體開始失控,忍者龜能拯救人類嗎?

programme.title: 長尾豹馬修一家親 [英/普]
programme.desc: 潔德同時答應幫助太多人,導致她分身乏術,反而製造更多混亂! // 答應等包裹卻錯過了的長尾豹們,一路追著宅配人員追到了物流站.

programme.title: 超豪妙宇宙 [英/普]
programme.desc: 優美市歡慶一年一度的美好節!豪豪與妙妙卻到處搗亂,惹惱所有市民. // 被驅逐一段時間後的豪豪與妙妙再次回到優美市,希望能修復與市民及彼此之間的關係.

programme.title: 超豪妙宇宙 [英/普]
programme.desc: 豪豪與妙妙幫忙照顧名叫「小刺刺」的仙人掌,最後卻掀起一場轟轟烈烈的搜索與搜救任務. // 豪豪與妙妙不打算讓臭臉褲褲打高爾夫,妨礙他們回家看最愛影集的大結局.

programme.title: 派大星秀 [英/普]
programme.desc: 派大星找其他的派大星來為派對帶來樂子. // 派托斯分享一則關於愛和豬肉製品的火腿尼亞故事.

programme.title: 派大星秀 [英/普]
programme.desc: 在意外穿上醫師的衣服後,派大星相信他自己是醫療專業人員. // 珍珍沒辦法和魷魚妹一起過夜,海星家自行舉辦睡衣派對.

programme.title: 派大星秀 [英/普]
programme.desc: 有個超級壞蛋回到他的舊巢穴,卻發現派大星一家住在那裡.

programme.title: 雷霆家族:雙生臥底
programme.desc: 由於失去了名聲和粉絲,麥斯決定打破布奇在海濱史帕特堆三明治的記錄,以重獲榮耀,但克洛伊向他發起挑戰,以便她的朋友可以重新獲得她的記錄.

programme.title: 超能勢力
programme.desc: 博斯發現,他愛上一名外星人後,開始發生怪事.

programme.title: 超能小子亨利

programme.title: 勞德之家 [英/普]

programme.title: 勞德之家 [英/普]
programme.desc: 露娜在她爸爸的新樂團演奏,她擔心朋友看到她表演時,會損壞她的名聲.// 麗莎發現阻止莉莉做惡夢的唯一方法,是由她自己進入莉莉的夢境來對抗它們.

programme.title: 勞德之家 [英/普]
programme.desc: 在馬斯托登營裡,阿玲大力鼓動格外謹慎的麗莎走出小木屋,擁抱戶外活動.

programme.title: 海綿寶寶 [英/普]

programme.title: 海綿寶寶 [英/普]
programme.desc: 失傳已久的海超人卡通終於要在電視上播放了,可是海綿寶寶能夠趕得及回家看到嗎? // 凱倫中了電腦病毒,要靠海綿寶寶去搶救她了!

programme.title: 海綿寶寶 [英/普]
programme.desc: 派大星睡不著,他尋求睡魔的幫忙.

programme.title: 勞德之家 [英/普]

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Liverpool are unbeaten on the opening day in the last 12 PL seasons (W9, D3) - the longest ongoing run in PL.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Between 2017-18 and 2023-24, Brighton and Hove Albion only avoided defeat in two of 14 Premier League games against Man City (W1 D1 L12); last season, they didn’t lose against City, winning 2-1 at home and drawing 2-2 at the Etihad.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: West Ham have won both of their last two Premier League games and are looking to win three in a row in the competition for the first time since December 2023.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Newcastle haven’t scored in any of their last four Premier League matches without Alexander Isak featuring (D2 L2), having 47 shots and accumulating an xG of 5.57 without scoring in these games.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Manchester City have won five of their last eight Premier League matches against Manchester United (D1 L2), though they failed to win either game (D1 L1) last season for the first time since 2020-21.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Arsenal have won five of their last six Premier League games against Tottenham (D1), including the last three in a row. It’s their longest winning run against Spurs since a five game stretch between January 1987 and January 1989.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Chelsea have won five of their last seven Premier League meetings with West Ham United (D1 L1), and overall have 32 wins in the competition against the Hammers, only beating Spurs more often (37).

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Crystal Palace are looking to remain unbeaten for a 13th consecutive Premier League game, which would set a new club record for unbeaten top-flight league games – the Eagles also had a 12 match run between May and October 1990.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Brighton completed a Premier League double over Tottenham Hotspur last season – the only time they have ever won back-to-back league meetings with Spurs.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Antoine Semenyo has scored (10) or assisted (4) 14 of Bournemouth’s last 18 Premier League goals (78%). Since the start of this period (14th April), this is at least three more goal involvements than any other player in the division.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Erling Haaland has scored 48 goals in 48 home Premier League appearances for Man City. The only player to hit 50 Premier League home goals in fewer than 50 appearances is Alan Shearer, who scored his 50th home goal in his 47th game.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Newcastle have kept four clean sheets in their five Premier League games this season, conceding only in their 3-2 defeat to Liverpool. However, the Magpies have also failed to score in three of their five league games so far.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Brighton have won each of their last three Premier League away games against Manchester United – the last side to win more consecutive league visits to Old Trafford were Manchester City between 1968 and 1972 (5).

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Having won four of their first six Premier League games against Chelsea between 1996 and 2001 (L2), Sunderland have since won just three of their 26 against the Blues (D2 L21).

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Having lost just one of their first three Premier League meetings with Liverpool (W1 D1), Brentford have now lost each of their last five against the Reds.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Manchester United have lost their last two away league games against Nottingham Forest, last losing three in a row at the City Ground between August 1965 and October 1967.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Arsenal have won two of their last four league meetings with Manchester City (D2), as many as their previous 22 beforehand (D5 L15). The Gunners could win back-to-back league games against the Citizens for the first time since December 2015.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Chelsea have won just one of their last 11 Premier League games against Arsenal (D3 L7) and are winless in seven (D2 L5) since a 2-0 win at the Emirates in August 2021.

programme.desc: In 2017, five full-grown great white sharks wash up dead on beaches in South Africa; biologist Alison Towner searches for orcas, the possible culprits in this grisly crime, in an effort to find out how great white sharks are being wiped out.

programme.title: Bull Shark Dinner Bell
programme.desc: Shark attack survivor Paul de Gelder and predator specialist Rosie Moore head to Jupiter, Florida to uncover what's fueling a surge in bull shark aggression. Testing weather, prey and human behavior, they build toward one explosive final demonstration.

programme.title: Jaws vs. Mega Croc
programme.desc: Using data gathered in new experiments, Tristan Guttridge, Rosie Moore and Dr. Sora Kim construct a CGI fight to the death between two of the apex predators in the water, the great white shark and Nile crocodile.

programme.title: Biggest Mako on Earth
programme.desc: A new report of a 15-foot mako shark off the coast of Mexico shatters conventional wisdom on how large these sharks can grow; a team of experts heads to the Pacific Ocean to track down this mega shark and find the biggest mako in the world.

programme.title: Jaws vs. Orca
programme.desc: Great white sharks are under siege by orcas; experts push into dangerous waters off the coast of Spain, provoking attacks on their boats to reveal how killer whales dominate their deadliest rival.

programme.desc: Floating on a raft of chum, Dr. Riley Elliott comes eye-to-eye with massive great whites while on a mission to lure and tag the culprit of a brutal shark attack spree that wrecked a tight-knit community in Australia.

programme.title: Invasion of the Mega Sharks
programme.desc: Off Nova Scotia's coast is rumored to be the elusive Big Rose, a female great white believed to be one of the largest predators in the North Atlantic. Using innovative tagging technology and daring field ops, a team attempts to find this ocean giant.

programme.title: How to Survive a Shark Attack
programme.desc: Shark attack survivor Paul de Gelder attempts to get attacked by a shark again; under the supervision of experts, Paul provokes sharks to attack him in multiple scenarios, where they bite and tear off prosthetic limbs to teach life-saving tactics.

programme.title: Fußball: Bundesliga der Frauen
programme.desc: Die Frauen-Bundesliga ist die höchste Spielklasse im deutschen Fußball für jene, die sich selbst als Frau identifizieren. Etabliert wurde die Liga 1989 durch den DFB-Bundestag, im Jahr darauf wurde der Spielbetrieb in zwei Staffeln zu je zehn Mannschaften aufgenommen. Seit 1997 wird die Frauen-Bundesliga bundesweit nach dem Vorbild der Männer eingleisig, jedoch mit nur zwölf Mannschaften ausgetrag

programme.title: Golf: Women's Open
programme.desc: In Lytham St Annes/Großbritannien. \nVor 50 Jahren wurde das Turnier erstmals ausgetragen, als Jenny Lee Smith gewann. Erst einmal konnte sich eine deutsche Spielerin in die Siegerliste eintragen: Sophia Popov 2020. Inzwischen geht die 33-Jährige als Mutter an den Abschlag.

programme.title: Tennis: ATP Tour und WTA Tour
programme.desc: Der Franzose Corentin Moutet startete im vergangenen Jahr als Lucky Loser erst in der zweiten Runde ins Teilnehmerfeld und wurde mit seinem Lauf bis ins Halbfinale fast zum glücklichen Sieger. In der Qualifikation für das Hauptfeld war Moutet am Chinesen Wu Yibing gescheitert. Für Moutet war es einer der größten Erfolge.
